svg.text: numgrid — how the package fits together
A narrated tour of NumPy over one availability cube of shape (30, 50, 91). Each box names the thing and then says what it does. Read the bands top to bottom: that is the order main() walks.
1 · RUNNING IT · one entry point, thirteen sections, and flags that let you run any subset
2 · THE FOUNDATION · the two modules that import nothing from the package
3 · THE CUBE · arrays.py is the only section that produces data; everything else consumes it
4 · THE MEMORY MODEL · shape, dtype, strides, and whether you hold a view or a copy
5 · SHAPES, BROADCASTING AND REDUCTIONS · where a wrong answer looks exactly like a right one
6 · LINEAR ALGEBRA, RANDOMNESS AND PERFORMANCE · the parts with a right answer and a measured one
7 · PITFALLS, PERSISTENCE AND VERIFICATION · six quiet failures, and the tools that catch them
8 · HOW IT IS PUT TOGETHER · and how to get value out of reading it
R · ONE RUN, END TO END · the order main() walks
